Introduction and Policy 1.1. The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and consequently the NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA), including its personnel, assets and facilities, enjoy immunity from jurisdiction. 1.2. Disputes at Procurement Authority Level related to the NCIA C ompetitive P rocurement process shall be exclusively and finally resolved in accordance with the procedure described herein . Matters arising after contract award, including disputes related to contract administration or performance, fall outside the scope of this procedure. 1.3. Definitions of terms found in Appendix 3, Annex 1, of “Procedure for NATO Competitive Procurement” apply unless otherwise stated below or in the solicitation. Bid : means a formal offer to provide goods, works, or services at a stated price under specified conditions, submitted in response to an NCIA solicitation. 2.3. Calendar Day : means a day, from 08:30 to 17:30 local time of the NCIA point of contact office specified in the solicitation for receipt of a complaint. For purposes of timeliness, if the final day to file a complaint falls on a calendar day on which that office is close d, the final day shall extend to the next calendar day on which that office is open . 2.4. NCIA may dismiss, without further consideration, any Compliant grounds that are : 3.3.2.1. related to deadlines; 3.3.2.2. untimely , absent NCIA granting an exception (see paragraph 3.2.5.2 ) ; 3.3.2.3. unsubstantiated; 3.3.2.4. merely expressing disagreement with NCIA’s exercise of discretion; or 3.3.2.5. concerning matters beyond the control, responsibility, or authority of NCIA. 4. Initial Notice and Review : 4.1.1. Upon receipt of a Complaint, NCIA will aim to confirm receipt with the filing Bidder, Interested Bidder, or Interested Party within two (2) C alendar D ays. The filer is a Bidder, Interested Bidder, or Interested Party; 4.1.2.2. The Complaint is timely; 4.1.2.3. The Complaint facially meet s all requirements stated in paragraph 3 of this Procedure and any additional requirements stated in the solicitation; 4.1.2.4. The Complaint alleges any grounds described in paragraph 3.3.2 ; and, 4.1.2.5. The requested relief is within NCIA’s ability to grant. 4.1.3. If NCIA determines that the C omplain t fails to satisfy a requirement under paragraph 4.1.2 , NCIA will advise the filing entity in writing with an explanation. 4.1.4. If the defic i ency is not related to timeliness, the filing Bidder, Interested Bidder, or Interested Party may re - file the Complaint once within two (2) calendar days from NCIA ’s written explanation. Such one - time re - fil ing will be considered timely. 4.2. Notice to Others : 4.2.1. If NCIA receives a Complaint that meets th
